observation_summary: The compiler crashes or reports an unexpected 'JSC_GOOG_SCOPE_NON_ALIAS_LOCAL' error when processing variables declared inside a goog.scope.
reasoning_summary: The bug occurs within the ScopedAliases pass, which attempts to rewrite local variables inside a goog.scope into global aliases. The original implementation incorrectly assumed that all variables within a scope were either aliases or invalid, failing to handle cases where variables were declared without initial values or were not qualified names. This led to both incorrect error reporting (JSC_GOOG_SCOPE_NON_ALIAS_LOCAL) and compiler crashes when the code attempted to access non-existent initial values or improperly construct AST nodes. The fix correctly updates the logic to handle variable declarations without initial values and ensures that only valid declarations are processed, while also improving the robustness of AST node creation in NodeUtil.
